name: Sadewa
source:
The second youngest of the Pandawa, Sadewa is Nakula's twin brother. He is innocent, naive and obedient (which isn't necessarily a good thing, since Nakula often gets him into one of his crazy schemes). He is very interested in herbal medicines, and can be found growing and gathering ingredients in the garden.
